h: Nigerians pray for Don Jazzy as he reportedly gives out millions amid extreme weather
p: Music executive Don Jazzy has reportedly shared millions of naira with followers as extreme weather linked to El Niño hits parts of the country. Fans have flooded his page with prayers and thanks.
more: The gesture comes amid concern over severe weather conditions.
Fans have praised his giving on social media.
